## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) — the DCO check must pass
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, ...)
- [ ] `pnpm check` passes locally (typecheck + lint + format + unit tests)
- [ ] Tests added/updated for changes to sync / CRDT / crypto behavior
- [ ] Build outputs (`extension/`, `extension-firefox/`, `dist/`) are not committed
- [ ] No secrets, real credentials or personal data added
